source.notes: The first generated sheet was rejected privately because a square overall canvas produced portrait cells that would distort when cropped. The approved second sheet is a true 1536x1024 landscape 3-by-2 grid with six square cells and a stable cumulative graphite process.

frames.visible_job: Draws one small head and neck joined to one simplified upright robe torso, with pale head axes and robe-drape routes.
frames.instruction: Draw a small upright oval for the head, add one pale center line and one pale eye line, then taper two short neck lines into sloping shoulders and one simplified robe torso. Add a few pale diagonal drape routes, keeping clear paper above the right shoulder for the torch.

frames.visible_job: Adds one arm rising from the right shoulder to one torch handle, bowl, and flame.
frames.instruction: Keep the pale head axes and robe routes. From the figure's right shoulder, draw one arm rising toward the upper left with a narrow sleeve and visible hand. Continue it into one straight ringed torch handle, one shallow bowl, and one simple flame.

frames.visible_job: Adds one bent left arm and one plain rectangular tablet overlapping the torso.
frames.instruction: Keep the pale head axes and robe routes. Bend the left arm across the lower chest and tuck one plain rectangular tablet against the figure's left side. Stop the robe lines behind the forearm and tablet.

frames.visible_job: Adds the calm face, wavy side hair, crown band, and exactly seven separated rays.
frames.instruction: Use the pale head axes to place two level eyes, a short straight nose, and one calm closed mouth. Add wavy hair, one crown band, and exactly seven separate pointed rays, then soften only the two head axes after the features replace them.
adds: face hair crown and seven rays
introduces: face hair crown and seven rays

frames.visible_job: Strengthens the established robe and sleeve folds, adds graphite modeling across the existing statue, and places one broken shadow beneath the bust.
frames.instruction: Follow the pale routes to draw the long robe and sleeve folds, soften only unused guide fragments, add graphite modeling across the established face, crown, torch, arms, tablet, and cloth, and place one broken shadow beneath the bust.
adds: robe folds graphite modeling and broken shadow
introduces: robe folds graphite modeling and broken shadow

final_step.visible_job: Layers muted sea green, warm ochre, and cool gray only over the established graphite statue, flame, and shadow.
final_step.instruction: Layer muted sea green lightly across the established statue, warm ochre inside the flame, and cool gray in the same broken shadow. Deepen only the existing graphite values, preserve paper highlights, and add no new contours.
adds: restrained color and graphite on established forms

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop contains one small centered head oval with two pale usable axes, a connected neck and shoulder line, one simple robe torso, and a few pale diagonal drape routes. It fixes the final scale and leaves generous upper-left paper for the raised arm and torch without showing later anatomy.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: I inspected the six saved square JPGs as a whole sequence and every adjacent pair at readable size. The head, shoulders, raised arm, torch, bent tablet arm, tablet, face, hair, crown band, seven rays, robe routes, crop, and shadow anchors remain spatially consistent; the two named guide lifecycles match the copy, and the finish changes only value and color.
